gen-dafont-klill-satoshi: Matched monoline: Klill and Satoshi share open curve endings and big lowercase. And that shared one-width build, big lowercase against a soaring x-height, is the quality that locks them.
gen-dafont-lemon-milk-poppins: Loose rolling-ball tracking marks every friendly Lemon Milk heading line. Lemon Milk shouts with open rounds, while Poppins holds a sans-serif line whose curves never knot.
gen-dafont-radikal-manrope: Radikal bends wire-like s curves and leaves a generous gap. Closed Radikal sits over open Manrope, whose mouths stay bright and the cap-to-lowercase step stays small.
gen-dafont-stilu-manrope: Blown-glass lowercase bowls mark Stilu, terminals never closing in. Manrope can drop a point, its open mouths and one-width pen still filling a whole column of copy.
gen-dafont-zag-fs-supreme: Crisp open letters in a heavy middle strip: that is how Supreme reads. And Zag keeps tight tracking that still reads when shrunk, so drop the copy a point under that oversized lowercase.
gen-dafont-znikomit-fs-merriweather-sans: Merriweather Sans feels sturdy, an e opening clearly to the right. Znikomit stays minimal at moderate height, so Merriweather Sans can run a sans-serif column without pinch.
gen-dm-serif-display-fs-asap: Ghostlike upstrokes against fat stems: DM Serif Display over Asap, open arcs and a near-capital lowercase on the line. High contrast over a high waist is the lock.
gen-dm-serif-display-fs-chillax: Dignified DM Serif Display flashes ghostlike upstrokes beside those fat stems. Razor hairlines against Chillax and its unfinished spaghetti line is the quality that holds the pair.
gen-dm-serif-display-general-sans: DM Serif Display flashes ghostlike upstrokes beside those bold downstrokes here. General Sans then glides as one-width wire through copy, so a column never sparkles into fatigue.
gen-dm-serif-display-manrope: Fat stems, faint upstrokes: DM Serif Display over open-mouthed Manrope below. Manrope keeps a sans-serif column moving, one-width pen and a small step from caps to lowercase.
gen-dm-serif-text-fs-asap: Asap stays readable, open c arcs nearly matching the capital height. And DM Serif Text swings fat to fine, so Asap can run a sans-serif column without that sparkle getting in the way.
gen-dm-serif-text-fs-chillax: DM Serif Text builds bookish stems with thread-thin arms on every letter. And Chillax can drop a point, spaghetti lines unfinished, under that editorial serif swing.
gen-dm-serif-text-fs-plein: Heavy stems, thread arms: DM Serif Text over Plein and its open channels. And Plein can drop a point, still a clear channel into every round letter under that serif swing.
gen-dm-serif-text-fs-spline-sans: Spline Sans comes through contemporary, gaps at every curve, matching stroke weight. And DM Serif Text parks hairline top curves over that sans-serif grid without fighting the matched stroke weight.
gen-dm-serif-text-outfit: Ink-heavy stems, feather lines: that is bookish DM Serif Text here. DM Serif Text does editorial swing best, while Outfit holds a sans-serif cable-bent line that never swells.
